about: Divit 2026-11-05 ("correct hyphenation and the exact keyword"): the written form of a keyword phrase in code-built text (breadcrumb, product name, explore CTA, FAQ heading, default definition questions) and in running text (skeleton.case_primary). Search keywords drop hyphens and proper-noun capitals; the page writes them correctly. QC keyword matching already treats a hyphen as a space, so the exact keyword still counts. Whole-phrase, case-insensitive; add a pair only when the phrase is always written this way in the hub's sense.
